Key findings: (1) Tasks ARE auto-generated when bookings are created - if no tasks appeared before, it was because there were no staff assigned to properties or bookings were past checkout date (2) Sync Tasks button works for regenerating tasks for existing bookings (3) Task types are correct: 'cleaning' for housekeepers, 'check_in'/'check_out' for co-hosts (4) Auto badge displays correctly on auto-generated tasks
